prompt.generated_prompt_string: Adult woman character reference figure 1. Hyper-realistic home daily life in a cozy living room with soft indoor lighting, realistic and natural cinematic image quality, first-person companion perspective. The adult woman sits on a sofa watching TV while eating potato chips; the camera is seated nearby. Actions and dialogue occur in strict chronological order with no overlap: 1. The camera perspective says, 'I also want potato chips.' 2. She smirks and says, 'Say please and I'll give you some.' 3. The camera perspective says, 'Please.' 4. She laughs, offers a chip toward the camera, then playfully pulls it back once. 5. She places a chip in a small bowl and hands the bowl toward the camera, saying, 'Okay, now you can have some.' Smooth natural movements, delicate realistic expressions, relaxed pace, friendly home-couple atmosphere, stable clear picture.
